title: HeartBEAM: Older Adult Resting State and Auditory Oddball Task EEG Data
description: EEG recordings from older adults during eyes-open and eyes-closed resting state and during passive and active auditory oddball tasks. Each participant was recorded under a control condition and an arousal condition induced by the threat of unpredictable shock. The data come from the HeartBEAM study and support research on locus coeruleus-noradrenaline system activity and arousal in aging.
methods_description: Five-minute eyes-open and eyes-closed resting state recordings and passive and active auditory oddball tasks (standard, target and distractor tones) were collected in a control condition and a shock-threat condition. Event markers code the task, condition, and trial phase.
